pages.text: A culture grows as its sugar allows, S/(Ks + S) (Monod), but too much sugar inhibits it, e^(−S/Si) (Haldane): the best level is √(Ks·Si). Yeast given air grows; without air it ferments instead (the Pasteur effect).
$(thing)Set$(): Sugar, Air.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Foaming: growth varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A culture near its best is fastest.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Growth, against its best: μ/μ_best = [S/(Ks + S)]·e^(−S/Si) / its peak$(br)Air: air
